name: Abe Takaya
source:
The team's catcher. A serious and mature character, whose short temper is often inadvertently provoked by Mihashi. He is very strategically minded and initially values Mihashi for his obedience in team games.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Big_Windup!#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
